import re

HDR = re.compile(r'^(?:"(?P<name>[^"]*)"\s+)?(?:#(?P<num>\d+)\s+)?(?:\[(?P<osid>\d+)\]\s+)?(?P<daemon>daemon\s+)?(?:prio=(?P<prio>\d+)\s+)?os_prio=(?P<os_prio>\d+)\s+cpu=(?P<cpu>\S+)\s+elapsed=(?P<elapsed>\S+)\s+tid=(?P<tid>\S+)\s+nid=(?P<nid>\S+)\s*(?P<status>.*?)\s*(?:\[(?P<addr>0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)\])?\s*$')
STATE = re.compile(r'^\s+java\.lang\.Thread\.State: (?P<state>\S+)(?: \((?P<detail>[^)]*)\))?\s*$')
FRAME = re.compile(r'^\s+at (?P<method>[^(\s]+)\((?P<source>.*)\)\s*$')
LOCK = re.compile(r'^\s+- (?P<action>.+?)\s+<(?P<obj>[^>]+)>(?: \(a (?P<cls>[^)]+)\))?\s*$')
TS = re.compile(r'^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d\s*$')
BANNER = re.compile(r'^Full thread dump (?P<vm>.*?):?\s*$')
SMR = re.compile(r'^_java_thread_list=(?P<list>\S+?),\s*length=(?P<len>\d+),\s*elements=\{\s*$')
ADDRS = re.compile(r'^\s*0x[0-9a-fA-F]+(?:,\s*0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)*,?\s*$')
JNI = re.compile(r'^JNI global refs: (?P<g>\d+), weak refs: (?P<w>\d+)\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    info = {'name': 'dump', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    kv = {}
    smr = {'name': 'smr_threads', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    th = {'name': 'threads', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    fr = {'name': 'frames', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    lk = {'name': 'locks', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    skip = []
    cur = None
    fidx = 0
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        m = HDR.match(l)
        if m and 'tid=' in l:
            cur = {'name': m.group('name') or '', '#': m.group('num') or '', 'os_thread_id': m.group('osid') or '', 'daemon': 'yes' if m.group('daemon') else 'no', 'prio': m.group('prio') or '', 'os_prio': m.group('os_prio'), 'cpu': m.group('cpu'), 'elapsed': m.group('elapsed'), 'tid': m.group('tid'), 'nid': m.group('nid'), 'status': m.group('status') or '', 'address': m.group('addr') or '', 'state': '', 'state_detail': '', 'note': ''}
            th['records'].append(cur)
            th['lines'].append(i)
            fidx = 0
            continue
        m = STATE.match(l)
        if m and cur is not None:
            cur['state'] = m.group('state')
            cur['state_detail'] = m.group('detail') or ''
            th['lines'].append(i)
            continue
        m = FRAME.match(l)
        if m:
            fr['records'].append({'thread': cur['name'] if cur else '', 'frame': fidx, 'method': m.group('method'), 'source': m.group('source')})
            fr['lines'].append(i)
            fidx += 1
            continue
        m = LOCK.match(l)
        if m:
            lk['records'].append({'thread': cur['name'] if cur else '', 'frame': fidx - 1, 'action': m.group('action'), 'object': m.group('obj'), 'class': m.group('cls') or ''})
            lk['lines'].append(i)
            continue
        if TS.match(l):
            kv['timestamp'] = s
            info['lines'].append(i)
            continue
        m = BANNER.match(l)
        if m:
            kv['vm'] = m.group('vm')
            info['lines'].append(i)
            continue
        m = SMR.match(l)
        if m:
            kv['_java_thread_list'] = m.group('list')
            kv['length'] = int(m.group('len'))
            info['lines'].append(i)
            continue
        if ADDRS.match(l):
            for a in re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+', l):
                smr['records'].append({'tid': a})
            smr['lines'].append(i)
            continue
        m = JNI.match(l)
        if m:
            kv['JNI global refs'] = int(m.group('g'))
            kv['weak refs'] = int(m.group('w'))
            info['lines'].append(i)
            cur = None
            continue
        if s in ('}', 'Threads class SMR info:'):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if cur is not None and l[:1] in (' ', '\t'):
            cur['note'] = (cur['note'] + '; ' + s) if cur['note'] else s
            th['lines'].append(i)
            continue
    if kv:
        info['records'].append(kv)
    blocks = [b for b in (info, smr, th, fr, lk) if b['lines']]
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
